gpu_model_source: job NodeList mapped through ARC_NODE_GPU (built-in 2026-10-04 listing); boards from NODE_GPU_VARIANT (htc-g003, htc-g004, htc-g015, htc-g016, htc-g032, htc-g033, htc-g034, htc-g035, htc-g037, htc-g038, htc-g041, htc-g042, htc-g043, htc-g053, htc-g054, htc-g055, htc-g058, htc-g059, htc-g060); a typed AllocTRES entry checked against the node
job_selection: this project's job names (evaluation.footprint.job_category), run from its directories, or from elsewhere under a name of _RUN_ELSEWHERE; every finished job that held an allocation, whatever its state

left_out_reasons.left_out_outside_project_dirs: run under one of this project's job names from another directory, so possibly another project's job
left_out_reasons.left_out_never_allocated: cancelled while pending: no allocation, so it ran on no node and drew no power
left_out_reasons.left_out_unfinished: still pending or running when the dump was taken, so its runtime was not final

note: sacct ConsumedEnergy is 0 for every job (no site energy-accounting plugin); figures are Green-Algorithms model estimates.
